title: trqp: answer a stale copy with a retryable trust-task-error, not a bare 503
description: The bare 503 exists because verify-trust before 0.25.0 read any trust-task-error as unauthorized. OpenVTC #176 (0.25.0) maps a retryable one to registryUnavailable, and the bridge now needs 0.27.0+. Switch the stale reply to a retryable trust-task-error/0.6 with retryAfter, once the end-to-end test (vouch-ius2) can confirm verify-trust 0.33.0 reports registryUnavailable for it. See docs/bridge-deployment.md, Freshness.
